name: Red Rose and Snow White
source:
The siblings Fleur and Blanche have lived a quiet, peaceful life with their mother in the forest. However, with the arrival of a young man and a bear--who introduce themselves as Rolf and Jerome, the princes of the kingdom--they decide to travel with them. Why they're traveling? To restore Jerome's humanity, of course, and to carry out justice to the one who cursed him.

[From [url=https://moonlightgardens.itch.io/red-rose-and-snow-white]itch.io[/url]]
